ui.tagline: Detect, explain and fix Azure AD errors
ui.input_sub: An AADSTS code, or just describe what happened in plain English.
ui.input_placeholder:
AADSTS900971: No reply address provided.

…or: "user can't sign in, says admin approval needed"
ui.readonly_hint: Read-only. Nothing is changed in your tenant.
ui.untranslated_notice: This description comes from Microsoft's documentation and is shown in English.
ui.fix_sub: Runs against your tenant through the Microsoft Graph API.
ui.signin_required_body: Sign in with a Microsoft admin account to apply this fix.
ui.subject: Subject

action.add_redirect_uri: Add the missing redirect URI to the app registration.
action.complete_consent_prompt: The user must accept the consent or terms prompt.
action.complete_mfa: The user needs to complete multi-factor authentication.
action.enable_account: Call MS Graph API PATCH /users/{id} with accountEnabled=true.
action.enable_or_unlock_account: Re-enable or unlock the user account in the directory.
action.escalate_to_admin: Generate an escalation message for the admin to invite the external user or configure B2B federation.
action.fix_app_registration: Review the app registration: identifier URI, audience, and reply URLs.
action.fix_request_format: The request is malformed. Check parameters and endpoint.
action.force_password_reset: Call MS Graph API PATCH /users/{id} with forceChangePasswordNextSignIn=true.
action.grant_admin_consent: An administrator must grant consent for the requested permissions.
action.manual_review: No automated remediation is mapped. Review the documented description below.
action.open_microsoft_support_ticket: Service-side issue. Open a Microsoft support ticket.
action.prompt_reauth: Prompt the user to re-enter credentials or reset their password.
action.provision_or_invite_user: Provision or invite the user into the tenant.
action.redirect_correct_tenant: Sign in with the correct work or school account.
action.reset_credentials: Have the user re-enter or reset their password.
action.restart_signout_flow: Restart the sign-out flow from the application.
action.retry: Wait 5-10 seconds and retry the authentication request.
action.retry_with_backoff: Transient failure. Retry with exponential backoff before escalating.
action.review_certificate_or_federation: Check the signing certificate or federation configuration.
action.review_conditional_access: Review the Conditional Access policies applying to this sign-in.
action.review_device_registration: Check the device registration or compliance state.
action.review_token_configuration: Inspect the token/assertion configuration and claim mappings.
action.rotate_app_secret: Call MS Graph API POST /applications/{id}/addPassword to add a new secret, then delete the old credential.
action.rotate_client_secret: Generate a new client secret and update the application.
action.trigger_consent_flow: Redirect the user to the consent URL with prompt=consent to force the consent screen.
action.trigger_interactive_login: Force an interactive sign-in instead of a silent token request.
action.unlock_account: Unlock the user account in the directory.
action.update_api_permissions: Correct the requested API permissions or scope.
